name: 3 tire 22. shell Dream Cature
shortDescription: A three-ring dream catcher made with .22 shells, paperclip cores, and continuous webbing; one of my most popular designs while I sold them.
description: This three-tier .22 shell dream catcher was one of my most popular designs while I was selling dream catchers. The standard version used three rings lined with .22 shells and then webbed together.
I used paperclips as the cores for the rings, strung the .22 shells onto them, and then completed the weaving. With no interruptions, I could make approximately one every other day.
